_about: My readings for the browse-group probe (src/probe_browse_report.py joins them to the measured numbers). Written by Claude after reading the printed sheets; they are judgement, not independent of the draft's author. Indexes are the order of build/browse_groups_reads_sheet.json (groups) and build/browse_groups_cards_sheet.json (cards).

top10.counterspell: 2 results: the merged page 'Counter a spell' and its member 'Counter a spell with targets'. Sensible, and one idea shown twice.
top10.flash: 7 results: 'Flash' appears twice (keyword filter and keyword block, same cards); 'Flashback' (a prefix match) and 'Flash + Flying' are noise for someone who wants flash; 2 results are real (cast as though it had flash). About 3 ideas.
top10.surveil: 5 results: 'Surveil' three times (leaf, loose group, community tag) + 'Surveil, then draw'; 'Exile a creature or planeswalker' is a description match with no connection. 2 ideas + 1 irrelevant.
top10.blink: 1 result: a hand-defined group with 0 cards placed. The page opens empty.
top10.menace: 10 shown of 17: 'Menace' twice (filter and block), 'Menace: other combinations', then seven groups that GRANT menace or mention it (tokens with menace, equipment that gives menace). About 3 ideas; the top 3 are one idea.
top10.cantrip: 1 result: a hand-defined group with 0 cards placed. Empty page.
top10.enchantment: 59 results; the top 10 are mostly distinct ideas (cost less, destroy, create tokens, cares about, return from graveyard). One twin pair ('Destroy an artifact or enchantment', leaf and tentative). Clutter here is breadth, not twins.
top10.zombie: 9 results: 3 are right (create Zombie tokens, with decayed, Zombie lords); the other 6 matched only by description and are unrelated ('Sacrifice a creature', 'Cast a card'). Noise from the description match.
top10.mana rock: 2 results: an empty hand-defined group ('Mana rocks', 0 cards) first, then 'Add colorless mana' (528 cards, which includes lands). The first click lands on nothing.
top10.artifact: 152 results; top 10 has two twin pairs (create artifact tokens leaf+tentative, destroy an artifact leaf+loose) and the empty 'Mana rocks' group. Mostly distinct ideas.

1: Reveal the top cards: six variants of one idea.
3: Land-type searches (Plains, Island ...) and 'search for a creature' are tutors, but 'Put a card in a library' (a zone-change group) is not a search.
5: Clone, copies creature, becomes a copy.
8: Theft tags: takes control of ... The name is jargon; the members fit.
12: Gain flying until end of turn; the name 'Jump' is slang a plain reviewer must rename.
13: Extra turn; the name 'Time walk' should be 'Extra turn'.
15: Artifact removal; the 'artifact or enchantment' groups are its second mapping.
17: Core (destroy a land, destroy all lands, land denial tag) is right. 'Puts more lands onto the battlefield' is ramp, and 'Changes land types' is not denial: the tag-slug root 'land' joined the word 'land' in the alias.
21: Eleven 'look at the top cards, put X into hand' variants.
28: 'Cast a card' and 'Cast cards from a graveyard' are close but not one choice; the loose group joined by name words.

1: its group 'Can't attack, sometimes only unless a condition' is a pillowfort group but is not mapped to the Pillowfort browse group
3: the 'destroy target nonbasic land' ability is in no group; it is also wrongly under Mana rock (it is a land)
4: dual land: 'Add mana of a fixed color' is mapped to Add mana, not Fixing (a judgment call: is a dual land fixing?)
7: its counter ability is in no counterspell group
8: 'Search your library for a Forest land ...' sits in 'Search your library and put it onto the battlefield', a sibling of Ramp, not in Ramp
10: also under 'Tap' for 'enters tapped', which a deckbuilder would not choose as Tap
11: colored-mana rocks are not in the Mana rock browse group (only 'Add colorless mana' is)
12: Recursion (named 'Return from a graveyard to its owner's hand')
18: present as 'Gains a keyword, gets +/-X/+/-X'; no 'Overrun / team pump' browse group exists by that name
21: no 'Ritual' group; it is in Add mana
22: the damage-to-each-creature ability is in no group
24: it is in 'Search your library', a sibling of the 'Tutor' browse group (same idea, two browse groups)
26: 'Destroy an artifact or enchantment an opponent controls' maps to Destroy; the same ability without 'an opponent controls' maps to Artifact removal
28: also a +1/+1 counter doubler; neither is in a group
33: only 'Synergy: cares about a particular thing'; no doubler group exists
34: 'Sacrifice another creature' as a cost is in no group
36: only 'Edict'; the return-to-battlefield ability is in no group
39: in Mana rock although it is a land
40: the 'draw a card' half is in no group

draw: Draw cards 1,100; Other: Card draw; Impulse draw; Card advantage (reasonable sub-ideas)
removal: no browse group named Removal: Spot removal, Destroy, Exile, Artifact removal, Disenchant, Edict, Burn ... (the word is only an alias)
ramp: Ramp (5 members), Add mana, Mana rock, Mana dork and 'Search your library and put it onto the battlefield' are separate
counterspell: Counterspell (304) and 'Counter a spell' (206, 14 members) are the same idea
tutor: Tutor, two 'Search your library and put ... into hand' groups and 'Search your library' (4 browse groups)
recursion: Reanimate; 'Return from a graveyard onto the battlefield'; '... to its owner's hand'; Regrowth
blink: only the hand-defined group, 0 cards; 'Exile' (48 variants) holds exile-then-return mixed with removal
mill: Mill (5), Target player mills, Each player/opponent mills ...
lifegain: Lifegain (812) and 'Gain life' (Life gain and loss, 131)
manadork: Mana dork, 10 cards (a tag); most mana creatures are only in Add mana
anthem: Anthem (208) plus pump groups that overlap in meaning
tokens: Create tokens (2,102 cards, 115 variants) with Treasure, Food, Blood, Clue ... split out
stax: Stax (98), Doesn't untap, Spells cost more
bounce: Bounce (179) and 'Return to its owner's hand' (441)
discard: Discard cards, Hand disruption, Thoughtseize, Each opponent discards
costred: Spells cost less (386) and Cost reduction (16)
extraturn: named 'Time walk', with no alias 'extra turn' on it
clone: Clone, Becomes a copy, Create a token copy
steal: Gain control, Steal, Threaten, Changes control
gyhate: Graveyard hate (146) and 'Exile from a graveyard' (169)
manarock: Mana rock (528), but it holds 'Add colorless mana', which includes lands

evasion: Evasion, Flying, Unblockable, Can't be blocked ...
